# BrandStory

> BrandStory is a full-service digital marketing agency headquartered in Deira, Dubai, UAE. Established in 2012, the agency serves 900+ clients — from SMEs to luxury and enterprise brands — across the Emirates and globally. Core offerings include SEO, PPC, social media marketing, email marketing, performance marketing, branding, content marketing, online reputation management (ORM), and website design & development. BrandStory is a certified Google Partner and Meta Partner agency with 100+ in-house experts.

BrandStory operates as a 360-degree digital marketing agency, blending data-driven strategy with creative execution. The agency follows a five-stage process: Competitor Research → Planning & Strategy → Trial & Testing → Campaign Implementation → Reporting & Optimization.

Key facts:
- Founded: 2012
- Team size: 100+ experts
- Campaigns executed: 1,000+
- Satisfied clients: 900+
- Office: G5, Al Meheri Plaza, opp DBC Building, Al Khabaisi Area, Deira, Dubai 81577, UAE
- Phone: +971 52 283 1655
- Email: info@brandstory.ae
- Certifications: Google Partner, Meta (Facebook) Partner, Ahrefs Agency Partner, TikTok Partner, Shopify Partner

Industries served: Education, E-commerce, Healthcare, Real Estate, Travel & Tourism, B2B Corporate, Dentistry, Automotive, Law Firms.

Service locations: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Fujairah, Ras Al Khaimah.

## Core Services

- [Digital Marketing Overview](https://www.brandstory.ae/): Full-service digital marketing for Dubai & UAE businesses — SEO, PPC, social media, email, branding, and web development under one roof.
- [SEO Services](https://www.brandstory.ae/seo-services-company-in-dubai/): Organic search optimisation including technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, keyword research, SEO audits, and local SEO.
- [PPC / Google Ads](https://www.brandstory.ae/pay-per-click-ppc-services-in-dubai/): Award-winning pay-per-click campaign management on Google and Bing for maximum ROI at minimal cost.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://www.brandstory.ae/social-media-marketing-agency-in-dubai/): Strategy and management across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Pinterest, and YouTube.
- [Performance Marketing](https://www.brandstory.ae/performance-marketing): Full-funnel, results-based performance marketing focused on measurable growth KPIs.
- [Email Marketing](https://www.brandstory.ae/email-marketing-company-in-dubai/): Campaign design, list management, and automation to nurture leads and drive conversions.
- [Content Marketing](https://www.brandstory.ae/content-marketing-agency-dubai/): Blog posts, articles, infographics, video scripts, and multimedia content strategy.
- [Online Reputation Management](https://www.brandstory.ae/online-reputation-management-services-in-dubai/): Monitoring and management of brand sentiment and professional standing online.
- [Branding Services](https://www.brandstory.ae/branding-agency-in-dubai/): Brand strategy, identity design, logo design, UI/UX design, and creative advertising.
- [Website Design & Development](https://www.brandstory.ae/website-development-company-in-dubai/): Custom websites, web design, WordPress, Magento, Drupal, Laravel, and e-commerce development.
